name: fragment-vocabulary
title: Fragment Vocabulary
description: A host that declares its own fragment vocabulary. Mods author UI as a typed node tree, not HTML. Run validate, typegen, and docgen against this manifest to see the vocabulary checked, typed, and documented.

log.description: Writes a message to the console.

ui-mount.description: Mount UI fragments into application slots.

slots.description: Panels a mod contributes to the sidebar, authored in the component vocabulary.

application/x-panel+json.description: The component vocabulary the sidebar renderer speaks.

Panel.description: A titled container. Holds any nested content, including other panels.
